subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` permanently use a 4 MiB limit while continuing to follow symlink chains?
rationale: The bound fixes a real memory risk, but the exact maximum and symlink behavior become public CLI compatibility choices, and the overlapping input PR proposes a different symlink policy.

options.title: Keep 4 MiB and symlinks
options.body: Retain this narrow compatibility-preserving implementation and document both behaviors before merge.

options.title: Adopt strict regular files
options.body: Coordinate with the broader input PR around rejecting symlinks and defining one unified file/stdin validation contract.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Select a different maximum and align implementation, tests, help, documentation, and real CLI proof.

recommendation.title: Keep 4 MiB and symlinks
recommendation.body: Retain this narrow compatibility-preserving implementation and document both behaviors before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the existing option and its documented compatibility behavior.
